prompts.series_annotator: Call build_fold_cot_context() FIRST to analyze the validation folds. Then return ONLY JSON with the SeriesProfile per the output schema in your instructions. No markdown, no explanation — only the JSON object.
prompts.strategy_selector: Call strategy_brief() FIRST — it contains the SeriesProfile and the full candidate library. Use series_profile fields to justify every selection. Return ONLY JSON per the output schema. No markdown, no explanation.

series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and strong seasonality with high noise levels. Concept drift and unstable rankings necessitate a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adjustment to adapt to changing model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift necessitates dynamic error weighting to adapt to changing model performance (Gaillard et al. 2015; Montero-Manso et al. 2020)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=ade_dynamic_error AND series_profile.recommended_knobs.top_k=4 → aligns with recommended top_k and uses inverse RMSE weighting as a robust alternative to dynamic error methods
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure (Timmermann 2006; M4 competition results)

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.recommended_knobs.top_k=4 AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few windows (Hansen et al. 2011; Genre et al. 2013)
